summary: This bill directs the Secretary of State to develop an international strategy for advancing artificial intelligence (AI) technologies to modernize and improve the resilience of electrical grids worldwide through partnerships, research, and deployment of AI-enabled grid technologies, and requires regular reports to Congress on its implementation.

scores.thoughts: The bill mentions national security as a reason for modernizing electrical grids and preventing cyber attacks, but it does not directly address military spending or defense operations. The focus is on civilian infrastructure resilience.

The bill promotes equitable access to advanced grid modernization tools in developing and vulnerable regions and authorizes the Secretary of State to support programs and provide technical assistance internationally. This constitutes a form of foreign aid aimed at infrastructure development.
